requirements.quote: Escrows one NFT
requirements.checkable: Each raffle escrows one configured NFT prize.

requirements.quote: sells fixed-price USDC entries
requirements.checkable: The USDC price per entry is fixed across purchases.

requirements.quote: one transferable ERC-721 ticket per purchase.
requirements.checkable: Each successful entry purchase creates exactly one ERC-721 ticket, regardless of the number of entries purchased.

requirements.quote: Ticket IDs are sequential
requirements.checkable: Successive ticket issuances use consecutive ticket IDs.

requirements.quote: map to one inclusive `[firstEntry,lastEntry]` uint128 range.
requirements.checkable: Each ticket maps to a single inclusive entry interval whose endpoints are uint128 values.

requirements.quote: Purchases, Chainlink callbacks, and winner proofs are O(1) in entry count.
requirements.checkable: Purchase work does not grow with the number of entries.

requirements.quote: Purchases, Chainlink callbacks, and winner proofs are O(1) in entry count.
requirements.checkable: Chainlink callback work does not grow with the number of entries.

requirements.quote: Purchases, Chainlink callbacks, and winner proofs are O(1) in entry count.
requirements.checkable: Winner-proof verification work does not grow with the number of entries.

requirements.quote: Tickets remain transferable bearer claims in every lifecycle state.
requirements.checkable: An existing, unburned ticket remains transferable in every raffle lifecycle state.

requirements.quote: Tickets remain transferable bearer claims until their owners burn them for redemption or refund.
requirements.checkable: The claim represented by an unburned ticket belongs to its current owner and follows ownership transfers.

requirements.quote: owners burn them for redemption or refund.
requirements.checkable: Obtaining a ticket refund requires the owner to burn the refunded ticket.

requirements.quote: Each raffle is a fixed, non-upgradeable ERC-1167 clone with no administrator or rescue path.
requirements.checkable: Each raffle instance uses the ERC-1167 minimal-proxy clone architecture.

requirements.quote: Each raffle is a fixed, non-upgradeable ERC-1167 clone with no administrator or rescue path.
requirements.checkable: A deployed raffle cannot change or upgrade its implementation.

requirements.quote: Each raffle is a fixed, non-upgradeable ERC-1167 clone with no administrator or rescue path.
requirements.checkable: A raffle exposes no administrator role or administrative control path.

requirements.quote: Each raffle is a fixed, non-upgradeable ERC-1167 clone with no administrator or rescue path.
requirements.checkable: A raffle exposes no asset-rescue path, including for unrelated NFTs forced into it as described at L410-L411.

requirements.quote: Permissionless settlement only allocates liabilities
requirements.checkable: Any caller can settle a valid winning ticket without a privileged role or ticket-owner authorization.

requirements.quote: the winning-ticket owner atomically burns the ticket while receiving the NFT or cash prize.
requirements.checkable: For an NFT win, burning the winning owner's ticket and delivering the NFT to that owner succeed or revert atomically.

requirements.quote: the winning-ticket owner atomically burns the ticket while receiving the NFT or cash prize.
requirements.checkable: For a cash win, burning the winning owner's ticket and delivering the cash to that owner succeed or revert atomically.

requirements.quote: First represented one-based global entry.
requirements.checkable: TicketRange.firstEntry denotes the first covered global entry using one-based numbering.

requirements.quote: Last represented one-based global entry.
requirements.checkable: TicketRange.lastEntry denotes the last covered global entry using one-based numbering.

requirements.quote: Historical ticket ranges remain stored after burns so indexers and callers can reconstruct entry coverage.
requirements.checkable: Burning a ticket preserves its stored historical entry range for subsequent reconstruction of coverage.

requirements.quote: True only while the wrapper request call is executing
requirements.checkable: _requestInFlight is never true outside the execution interval of the wrapper request call.

requirements.quote: a synchronous callback cannot resolve early.
requirements.checkable: A callback arriving synchronously during the wrapper request cannot resolve the raffle before that request completes.

requirements.quote: Deploys and locks the implementation shared by one factory's minimal-proxy raffles.
requirements.checkable: Deployment locks the implementation itself against subsequent raffle initialization.

requirements.quote: the implementation shared by one factory's minimal-proxy raffles.
requirements.checkable: The minimal-proxy raffles belonging to one factory share its implementation.

requirements.quote: Constructor state belongs to the implementation.
requirements.checkable: Constructor storage writes affect the implementation rather than initializing clone storage.

requirements.quote: Clones share these immutables
requirements.checkable: Every clone uses the immutable configuration embedded in the shared implementation.

requirements.quote: hold isolated storage.
requirements.checkable: Each clone has independent mutable storage, isolated from the implementation and other clones.

requirements.quote: Canonical six-decimal USDC contract fixed for the implementation and every clone.
requirements.checkable: The configured quoteToken_ is assumed to identify canonical USDC; the deployment context must establish that identity.

requirements.quote: Canonical six-decimal USDC contract fixed for the implementation and every clone.
requirements.checkable: The configured quote token is assumed to have six decimal places.

requirements.quote: Canonical six-decimal USDC contract fixed for the implementation and every clone.
requirements.checkable: The quote-token address is fixed for the implementation and identical across all its clones.

requirements.quote: Chainlink VRF v2.5 native direct-funding wrapper fixed for the implementation and all clones.
requirements.checkable: The configured vrfWrapper_ is a Chainlink VRF v2.5 wrapper supporting native direct funding.

requirements.quote: Chainlink VRF v2.5 native direct-funding wrapper fixed for the implementation and all clones.
requirements.checkable: The VRF-wrapper address is fixed for the implementation and identical across all its clones.

requirements.quote: Raised when native currency is sent outside the payable draw-request path.
requirements.checkable: Native-currency sends outside the payable draw-request path raise DirectNativeTransfer, within the scope stated by this error documentation.

requirements.quote: Rejects direct native-token transfers that are not attached to `requestDraw`.
requirements.checkable: The direct native-token receive path rejects transfers rather than accepting them outside requestDraw.

requirements.quote: Accepts only the exact configured prize deposited by the factory for the sponsor.
requirements.checkable: The ERC-721 receiver accepts a prize only from the configured prize-token contract; token ID, operator, and previous owner are separate requirements below.

requirements.quote: Unrelated NFTs forced here with unsafe `transferFrom` remain outside protocol accounting
requirements.checkable: An unrelated NFT deposited using unsafe transferFrom does not enter protocol prize or liability accounting.

requirements.quote: ERC-721 transfer operator, which must be the canonical factory.
requirements.checkable: onERC721Received accepts only an operator equal to the canonical factory.

requirements.quote: Previous owner, which must be the configured sponsor.
requirements.checkable: onERC721Received accepts only a from address equal to the configured sponsor.

requirements.quote: Transferred token ID, which must match the configured prize.
requirements.checkable: onERC721Received accepts only the configured prizeTokenId.

requirements.quote: ERC-721 receiver acceptance selector.
requirements.checkable: A successful onERC721Received call returns the ERC-721 receiver acceptance selector.

requirements.quote: Exact ERC-721 collection name, `raffle.fun Ticket`.
requirements.checkable: name() always returns raffle.fun Ticket for every raffle ticket collection, as also stated at L477.

requirements.quote: Exact ERC-721 collection symbol, `RAFFLE`.
requirements.checkable: symbol() always returns RAFFLE for every raffle ticket collection, as also stated at L483.

requirements.quote: Known protocol sinks are rejected before their ownership could make a claim unreachable.
requirements.checkable: Ticket ownership updates reject known protocol-sink recipients before those recipients acquire ownership.

requirements.quote: Burns pass the zero address
requirements.checkable: A ticket burn passes address(0) as the destination of the ownership update.

requirements.quote: Burns pass the zero address and remain permitted.
requirements.checkable: The ticket-destination screen permits the zero-address destination used for otherwise valid burns.

requirements.quote: Caller whose owner or operator authority is checked by ERC-721.
requirements.checkable: ERC-721 checks the supplied auth caller's owner or operator authority for an authorized ownership update.

requirements.quote: Ticket owner before the update, or the zero address for a mint.
requirements.checkable: _update returns the ticket's owner from before a non-mint ownership update.

requirements.quote: Ticket owner before the update, or the zero address for a mint.
requirements.checkable: _update returns address(0) when minting a ticket.

requirements.quote: Authenticated randomness selects only an entry.
requirements.checkable: Randomness resolution selects an entry rather than identifying a winning ticket or choosing a ticket owner.

requirements.quote: No ticket search, loop, user call, or token transfer occurs.
requirements.checkable: The randomness callback performs no ticket search.

requirements.quote: No ticket search, loop, user call, or token transfer occurs.
requirements.checkable: The randomness callback executes no loop.

requirements.quote: No ticket search, loop, user call, or token transfer occurs.
requirements.checkable: The randomness callback makes no user call.

requirements.quote: No ticket search, loop, user call, or token transfer occurs.
requirements.checkable: The randomness callback performs no token transfer.

requirements.quote: In-flight, late, wrong-request, duplicate, and ABI-decodable wrong-length callbacks are ignored for liveness
requirements.checkable: An ABI-decodable callback arriving while the wrapper request is in flight is ignored without resolving or reverting in the handler.

requirements.quote: In-flight, late, wrong-request, duplicate, and ABI-decodable wrong-length callbacks are ignored for liveness
requirements.checkable: An ABI-decodable callback arriving after its permitted callback window is ignored without resolving or reverting in the handler.

requirements.quote: In-flight, late, wrong-request, duplicate, and ABI-decodable wrong-length callbacks are ignored for liveness
requirements.checkable: An ABI-decodable callback for a different request ID is ignored without resolving or reverting in the handler.

requirements.quote: In-flight, late, wrong-request, duplicate, and ABI-decodable wrong-length callbacks are ignored for liveness
requirements.checkable: An ABI-decodable duplicate callback is ignored without changing the existing resolution or reverting in the handler.

requirements.quote: In-flight, late, wrong-request, duplicate, and ABI-decodable wrong-length callbacks are ignored for liveness
requirements.checkable: An ABI-decodable callback whose randomWords length is not exactly one is ignored without resolving or reverting in the handler; L508 specifies the required length.

requirements.quote: malformed ABI calldata reverts during Solidity decoding before this handler runs.
requirements.checkable: Malformed ABI callback calldata causes a revert.

requirements.quote: malformed ABI calldata reverts during Solidity decoding before this handler runs.
requirements.checkable: Malformed ABI callback calldata is rejected by Solidity decoding before fulfillRandomWords executes.

requirements.quote: Wrapper-authenticated request identifier supplied by the callback.
requirements.checkable: The callback request identifier reaches the handler through authentication by the configured wrapper.

requirements.quote: Validates the winning range once
requirements.checkable: A raffle validates and settles its winning range only once.

requirements.quote: allocates all terminal quote-token liabilities
requirements.checkable: Successful winning-ticket settlement allocates every terminal quote-token liability.

requirements.quote: without transferring an asset or reading ticket ownership.
requirements.checkable: Winning-ticket settlement transfers no asset; it records liabilities as also stated at L25.

requirements.quote: without transferring an asset or reading ticket ownership.
requirements.checkable: Winning-ticket settlement performs no ticket-ownership read.

requirements.quote: Both percentage allocations round down
requirements.checkable: The protocol-fee percentage allocation rounds down to whole raw quote-token units.

requirements.quote: Both percentage allocations round down
requirements.checkable: The cash-winner percentage allocation rounds down to whole raw quote-token units.

requirements.quote: sponsor proceeds are the remainder.
requirements.checkable: Sponsor proceeds equal the settled pot minus the protocol-fee allocation and any cash-winner allocation.

requirements.quote: Ticket whose inclusive range must contain the selected winning entry.
requirements.checkable: A candidate winning ticket must satisfy firstEntry <= winningEntry <= lastEntry; the helper at L577 specifies rejection otherwise.

requirements.quote: Raw six-decimal quote-token units allocated to the cash winner, or zero for `NftWon`.
requirements.checkable: _settleWinningTicket returns the cash-winner allocation in raw six-decimal quote-token units for a cash outcome.

requirements.quote: Raw six-decimal quote-token units allocated to the cash winner, or zero for `NftWon`.
requirements.checkable: _settleWinningTicket returns zero cashAmount for NftWon.

requirements.quote: Transfers one complete current USDC claim through SafeERC20 after rejecting known protocol sinks.
requirements.checkable: _transferQuote transfers the entire current USDC claim being released.

requirements.quote: Transfers one complete current USDC claim through SafeERC20 after rejecting known protocol sinks.
requirements.checkable: _transferQuote uses SafeERC20 for the USDC transfer.

requirements.quote: Transfers one complete current USDC claim through SafeERC20 after rejecting known protocol sinks.
requirements.checkable: _transferQuote rejects a known protocol-sink recipient before attempting the USDC transfer.

requirements.quote: The canonical USDC trust model assumes standard, non-rebasing, fee-free transfer semantics.
requirements.checkable: Not fully checkable from this document: standard transfer semantics is undefined beyond the separately stated non-rebasing and fee-free assumptions.

requirements.quote: The canonical USDC trust model assumes standard, non-rebasing, fee-free transfer semantics.
requirements.checkable: The configured USDC is assumed not to rebase balances; this is an external token assumption rather than an asserted Raffle validation.

requirements.quote: The canonical USDC trust model assumes standard, non-rebasing, fee-free transfer semantics.
requirements.checkable: The configured USDC is assumed to transfer without fees; this is an external token assumption rather than an asserted Raffle validation.

requirements.quote: Immutable or owner-derived recipient of the claim.
requirements.checkable: Every _transferQuote recipient is either a fixed claim recipient or derived from the current ticket owner.

requirements.quote: Raw six-decimal USDC units transferred.
requirements.checkable: _transferQuote interprets amount as raw six-decimal USDC units.

requirements.quote: Reverts unless the raffle is in the expected lifecycle state.
requirements.checkable: _requireStatus reverts whenever the current raffle status differs from the supplied expected status.

requirements.quote: Reverts unless the supplied ticket's stored inclusive range contains the selected winning entry.
requirements.checkable: _requireWinningTicket reverts when winningEntry is outside the supplied ticket's stored inclusive range.

requirements.quote: True when the address is known same-factory protocol plumbing.
requirements.checkable: _isProtocolDestination returns true for an address known to be protocol plumbing of the same factory.

requirements.quote: Initialization supplies the prospective prize token
requirements.checkable: Initialization-time destination screening passes the prospective configured prize-token address.

requirements.quote: clone storage is not populated yet
requirements.checkable: Initialization-time destination screening occurs before the clone's prize-token storage has been populated.

requirements.quote: runtime checks pass the stored prize token.
requirements.checkable: Runtime destination screening passes the prize-token address stored in the raffle.

requirements.quote: Code-less addresses are not queried in the registry.
requirements.checkable: Destination screening does not query the raffle registry about an address whose code length is zero.

requirements.quote: Configured or prospective prize-token address to reject.
requirements.checkable: Destination screening rejects the supplied configured or prospective prize-token address.

requirements.quote: Validates the wrapper before passing it to the inherited constructor initializer.
requirements.checkable: The wrapper address is validated before it is passed to the inherited constructor initializer.

requirements.quote: The same nonzero wrapper address.
requirements.checkable: _validatedVrfWrapper cannot successfully return a zero wrapper address.

requirements.quote: The same nonzero wrapper address.
requirements.checkable: _validatedVrfWrapper returns the same wrapper address it was supplied on success.
